title: Security & Access Control - Quiz
description: Test your understanding of security and access control concepts in PEGA

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of Access Control in PEGA?
options: To manage user permissions and restrict access to sensitive data
questions.explanation: Access Control manages user permissions and restricts access to sensitive data, ensuring that users only see and modify data appropriate to their role and responsibilities.

questions.question: When should you use role-based access control (RBAC)?
options: To organize permissions based on job functions and responsibilities
questions.explanation: Role-based access control organizes permissions based on job functions and responsibilities, providing scalable and maintainable security management.

questions.question: How do you implement field-level security?
options: Through access control policies and conditional visibility rules
questions.explanation: Field-level security is implemented through access control policies and conditional visibility rules that dynamically show or hide fields based on user permissions.

questions.question: What is the benefit of authentication policies?
options: They provide centralized user authentication and session management
questions.explanation: Authentication policies provide centralized user authentication and session management, ensuring consistent security across all application components.

questions.question: How should you handle sensitive data encryption?
options: Through comprehensive encryption at rest and in transit
questions.explanation: Sensitive data should be protected through comprehensive encryption at rest and in transit, using industry-standard encryption algorithms and key management.

questions.question: What is the purpose of audit trails in security?
options: To track user actions and maintain compliance records
questions.explanation: Audit trails track user actions and maintain compliance records, providing accountability and supporting regulatory requirements and security investigations.

questions.question: How do you implement least privilege access?
options: By granting minimum necessary permissions for each role
questions.explanation: Least privilege access is implemented by granting minimum necessary permissions for each role, ensuring users only have access to resources required for their job functions.

questions.question: What is crucial for security testing and validation?
options: Comprehensive security testing, penetration testing, and regular audits
questions.explanation: Security testing requires comprehensive security testing, penetration testing, vulnerability assessments, and regular audits to identify and remediate security issues.
